correctness.rationale: The precise finite theorem follows from the character orthogonality/difference-set equivalence, exact cyclotomic coefficient pairing at exponents 2,4,8,16, and exhaustive enumeration of all tiling factorization pairs. Two standalone independently structured pure-Python programs were actually run: recursive cover plus clique and direct full-subset pairs plus candidate-spectrum mask scanning. Both returned identical total and size-stratified counts for all five groups, and independently excluded all subgroup spectra for each obstruction. The frequency/translation normalizations are proved in RESULT.md; no unproved infinite extrapolation.

originality.rationale: The 1997 universal-spectrum criterion, cyclic prime-power existence theorem, and the earlier exact Z4-squared entry already cover portions of the claim. The asserted new contribution is the full five-isomorphism-type table of universal complement incidence and subgroup-coset obstructions (764, 1056, 1168, 896, 0), including complete size strata. Bounded scientific searches found no theorem or exact database covering this combined table. Strong existing partial coverage is identified rather than credited as new.

value.rationale: A complete natural classification of simultaneous character bases for all five groups of order sixteen, under the meaningful stricter constraint of subgroup-coset frequency sets. It distinguishes elementary from non-elementary order-sixteen abelian groups at a fixed size and measures how often each class requires nonlinear frequency geometry. Prior individual tile censuses and the Z4-squared special case are explicitly subtracted from novelty; the comparative complete invariant remains a motivated exact fact.
